methods.doc: Recompute the map cursor for the active control, tool and spell-area placement, and apply it to #board (this browser only). Returns the cursor key, or null for the system arrow.
The cursor key on #board now, or null (system arrow, setting off, or no canvas).

params.name: state
params.doc: templatesActive: a spell-area placement is following the mouse

methods.doc: Pure: the cursor key for a control/tool state, ignoring the setting.

methods.returns: { enabled, key, control, tool, placementActive, boardCursor, dataset, imageSet, expected }
methods.doc: Read-only diagnosis of a wrong cursor in one call: the setting, the active control/tool, whether a placement is live, #board's style.cursor and data-pentaryn-cursor, image-set support, and the key expected (key is null while the setting is off). Writes nothing.

settings.doc: Per browser: show the active scene tool on the map's mouse pointer. Off → Foundry's own cursors, and a blanked #board cursor is no longer repaired. Read live, so no reload.
